# Silvaplana, Switzerland

Last updated: 2026-10-29 21:30:53 UTC

## Overview

- Spot ID: 1584
- Coordinates: 46.45667, 9.79270
- Type: Mountain lake
- Best wind: SW (Thermal, Maloja wind)
- Water temperature: 5-18°C
- Experience: Intermediate
- Launch: Lake shore
- Hazards: Cold water, altitude

### Description

World-famous alpine lake spot in Engadin valley with reliable thermal winds.
